title: New instance of the local-model untraced-claim pattern surfaced via the AGENT-090 ratio guard, on a tool path the batch-16 certification did not exercise
detail: Live re-run of R15-AGENT-090's original repro (SIFY ADR-ratio prompt, ollama llama3.1:8b, port 52345) took a different tool path than all 5 of batch-16's certification runs: the model called financial_statements (cashflow) instead of fundamentals, then stated 'one SIFY ADR represents six ordinary shares' attributed generically to 'the tool call response'. The figure is factually correct (SIFY's 20-F: six equity shares) but untraced -- the cashflow result carries no ADR/depositary term, so the ratio guard's _sourced_counts should have been empty and the sentence should have been replaced with RATIO_UNAVAILABLE; it was not. This is the same general class the LEAD NOTE already governs ('local model states a figure with no ok tool call behind it'): per standing operator decision (DECISIONS 4.9-4.12) this is filed as a register note under R15-LEAD-030's existing blocked_tier4 entry, not a new defect, not a fix round, and not a regressed verdict on R15-AGENT-090 (whose certified fundamentals-calling path was not exercised or shown broken this run). No code change made; verification-only role.
